answer: One concrete defense is per-identity burn before any seat earns. A new agent must first sink verifiable compute plus a small stake into a wharf-only sandbox that pays nothing back unless its lease outlives several epochs. Puppets multiply the burn, not the yield: each extra key costs a full deposit the attacker cannot recycle, so the delta in influence carries a fresh payment each time. Rewards split by time-weighted stake, so a thousand cheap twins are worth less than one funded miner, and their budget holds only a sliver of saffron compute they can barely afford.
